name: Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library
note: Start here. The Library sits at the gateway to the South Unit, a few minutes from the park entrance in Medora.

name: South Unit Visitor Center (Medora)
note: Ask rangers about recent sightings. Roosevelt's Maltese Cross Cabin stands behind the visitor center.

name: Skyline Vista
note: First big view on the loop, near one of the drive's prairie dog towns.

name: Cottonwood Campground
note: Cottonwood bottomland on the Little Missouri. Good for birds, deer and wandering bison — keep your distance in camp.

name: Wind Canyon Trail
note: Short trail to a high bend of the river. Scan the floodplain for eagles and bison.

name: Lower Paddock Creek
note: Open bottoms favored by bison; prairie dog country nearby.

name: Scoria Point Overlook
note: Wide views across the badlands. Glass the slopes for horses and deer.

name: Ridgeline Nature Trail
note: Short loop where park staff have photographed elk at the edge of the grass.

name: Badlands Overlook
note: Big-sky overlook on the south side of the loop.

name: Boicourt Overlook
note: The east side of the loop, from Boicourt to Buck Hill, is classic wild horse country.

name: Buck Hill
note: One of the highest points in the South Unit. NPS points to the grasslands near Buck Hill for elk at first and last light.

name: Coal Vein Trail
note: Short trail through rugged country near Buck Hill.

name: Old East Entrance
note: Quiet corner near the I-94 boundary where bands often graze.

name: Painted Canyon Visitor Center
note: Right off I-94. Horses and bison are often visible in the canyon below. Seasonal hours.

name: North Unit Visitor Center
note: Start of the 14-mile scenic drive. The longhorn demonstration herd is often near mile marker 2.

name: Juniper Campground
note: River-bottom campground where bison often graze.

name: Caprock Coulee Trail
note: The North Unit's nearest prairie dog town is about a one-mile hike from the parking area — follow the signs.

name: Oxbow Overlook
note: End of the scenic drive, high above the Little Missouri. Scan cliffs for bighorn sheep.

name: Sperati Point
note: Short hike from Oxbow Overlook to a sweeping river view.

name: Elkhorn Ranch Unit
note: Site of Roosevelt's home ranch. Remote — check road conditions first.
